final: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / o.average_cost_ratio AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC, i.invoice_number LIMIT 10
